## Phase 2: greedy V-cycles (hard, 1000 boards, baseline 84.3%)

Each cycle re-encodes the current board and regenerates from the restart level at temperature 0. *Checker-gated* cycles only boards the Sudoku checker rejects. *Residual-gated* cycles only the boards whose level-local residual is in the top q (no checker, no solution). Extra NFE is the mean per board over all cycled boards, summed over cycles (gating would lower it).
